_owner: wizard — written by `togo builder new`. Regenerated on re-run unless the operator edited it (see manifest.json). No agent may write this file.
_purpose: Project identity. These values ARE the {{tokens}} every baseline rule and CLAUDE.md substitutes. Rules never hard-code a project fact; they point here.

identity._note: What this is, in one paragraph. Feeds CLAUDE.md's 'What this is' section.
identity._is_not_note: Non-goals matter more than goals for an agent. An explicit 'NOT' is the cheapest way to stop a run inventing scope.

_surfaces_note: Array of declared UI/API surfaces, e.g. ["public-site", "admin", "api"]. Drives: Rule 01 (plan-first checklist), Rule 14 (component design ships only when a web surface exists), and the per-surface agent archetype in team.yaml. Each surface carries its own boundary; an agent that owns `admin` stops at `/admin/*`.
_locales_note: Array of BCP-47 tags, e.g. ["en"] or ["en","ar"]. Rule 15 (bilingual content) ships live only when length > 1; monolingual projects get a one-line inert version. An RTL locale here also turns on the RTL clauses in Rule 14.

stack.backend: togo (Go · sqlc · Atlas · chi · REST/OpenAPI · GraphQL)
stack._generated_note: Never hand-edited. Change the source of truth and run `togo generate`. Enforced by guard-generated-files.sh and Rule 11.

vcs._trunk_note: The integration branch. Rule 27's promotion path starts here.
vcs._prod_ref_note: The ref that IS production — a branch, a tag pattern, or the trunk itself when promotion_mode is merge-is-deploy.
vcs._promotion_mode_note: One of: pr | fast-forward | merge-is-deploy. When it is `merge-is-deploy`, Rule 27 collapses to 'the PR review is the only gate' and says so explicitly — there is no second checkpoint, and pretending otherwise is how a bad merge reaches users.
vcs._commit_trailer_note: Rule 42 — agent, model, run id and issue on every commit.

_envs_note: Ordered array of environment names, lowest to highest, e.g. ["dev","stage","prod"]. The wizard generates one promotion rule per adjacent pair.
_env_matrix_note: Rendered table: env -> branch/ref, URL, database name, deploy target. Substituted into CLAUDE.md's Environments section and printed by session-init.sh. Database names listed here must also appear in hook-config.json `protected_databases` for every non-ephemeral env.
_api_base_note: Base URL of the running API for the default env. Rule 28's fourth evidence layer is `curl {{api_base}}/openapi.json` and asserting the new route exists — a free verification layer togo gets for nothing.
_iac_note: Nullable. `null` when the project declares no infrastructure-as-code — Rules 24 and 25 are then NOT SHIPPED at all, rather than shipped as dead prose. When non-null: { "tool": "terraform|pulumi|cdk", "dir": "infra/", "modules": [...] }. Module paths mirror into hook-config.json.
_observability_note: Nullable. When non-null the `sre-oncall` agent is rendered and Rule 36's telemetry clause becomes checkable. Shape: { "logs": "...", "metrics": "...", "traces": "...", "dashboard_url": "..." }.
_integrations_note: External systems the project talks to. Each produces an integration agent (team.yaml) and a named secret in the vault. Referenced BY NAME only — never a value, anywhere in .claude/ (Rule 34).

commands._codegen_note: sqlc -> gqlgen -> OpenAPI. The OpenAPI export is the compile gate. `togo generate` must leave the tree diff-clean; a dirty tree after codegen is a failed definition of done (Rule 05).
commands._build_note: Build, not just typecheck — Rule 05. A green typecheck over a bundle that does not build is the exact shape of a false 'done'.

_tree_note: Rendered directory outline for CLAUDE.md's Layout section. Kept to one screen — an agent needs orientation, not an inventory.
